question.text: What will be the average price of diesel in the lower Atlantic U.S. on December 28, 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as the average price of Lower Atlantic On-Highway Diesel in dollars per gallon for December 28, 2026 according to the U.S. Energy Information Administration's [Gasoline and Diesel Fuel Update](https://www.eia.gov/petroleum/gasdiesel/) for or closest to that date.

research:
Status: I've finished the research and am writing it up.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-10-27 release: Lower Atlantic (PADD 1C) on-highway diesel was **$5.890/gal for 2026-10-26**. That is up $0.150 on the week and $2.248 on the year. The U.S. average was $6.352, the East Coast $6.079, Central Atlantic $6.496 and New England $6.421. The next release is 2026-11-03. [EIA](https://www.eia.gov/petroleum/gasdiesel/)
- 2026-12-28 is a Monday, so the resolving figure is the price dated 12/28. Because of the holiday it may be published on Tuesday 12/29 or a little later.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question. Resolution is about 8.5 weeks away and prices are moving a lot. The Lower Atlantic price is near its 2026 high: it peaked at $6.139 on 09-21 and then fell to $5.645 on 10-12.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)

He signed an executive order letting trucks use untaxed red-dyed diesel on highways and made a deal for about 6M barrels of Russian diesel through November, which analysts call too small to matter. Trump says he won't strike Iran before the 11-03 midterms, but markets are pricing in a risk of fighting after the vote. GasBuddy's Patrick De Haan warns of a spike before Thanksgiving if things escalate. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/31/trump-gas-diesel-price-midterm-election.html)
- 2026-10-30: Brent for December delivery was about $116 and WTI about $103 (news API, Quotidiano). BMI expects high diesel prices to last through Q1 2027 because of restricted transit through Hormuz (news API, [Trend](https://www.trend.az/world/4240943.html)).
- 2026-10-28: AAA's U.S. diesel average was $6.35, up 7 cents after the Trump-Putin diesel announcement (news API, citing WSJ). [capital.ua](https://www.capital.ua/ru/news/180676-wsj-ugoda-iz-rosiyeyu-ne-dopomozhe-suttyevo-zniziti-tsini-na-palne-u-ssha-ta-sviti)
- 2026-10-27/29: Reported Houthi strikes on Saudi refineries, including Ras Tanura, plus Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries. Oil is heading for a fourth straight monthly gain. [NSJ](https://nationalsecurityjournal.org/american-drivers-just-got-handed-more-bad-news-oil-is-headed-for-a-fourth-straight-monthly-gain-as-fears-of-new-iran-strikes-build/), [NBC](https://www.nbcnews.com/business/energy/oil-prices-stocks-trump-iran-rcna602248)

- I could not find a ULSD futures settlement for late October.

## 4. Base rates and history (Lower Atlantic weekly, EIA) [EIA series](https://www.eia.gov/dnav/pet/hist/LeafHandler.ashx?n=PET&s=EMD_EPD2D_PTE_R1Z_DPG&f=W)
- 2026 path: $3.81 (03-02), then $5.62 (04-06), $4.48 (07-06, the post-shock low), $6.14 (09-21, the high), $5.65 (10-12) and $5.89 (10-26).
- Recent weeks: 09-28 $5.953, 10-05 $5.699, 10-12 $5.645, 10-19 $5.740, 10-26 $5.890.
- Changes over about 9 weeks in 2026: Mar-May +$1.52; Apr 27 to Jun 29 -$0.68; Jul 27 to Sep 28 +$0.70; Aug 24 to Oct 26 +$0.54. In a calm year the move is much smaller: from 2025-10-27 to 2025-12-29 the price went from $3.642 to $3.522 (-$0.12). Late-2025 seasonality was a small rise in November and then a decline through December.
- Lower Atlantic sits below the U.S. average. The gap was -$0.53 on 10-12, -$0.54 on 10-19 and -$0.46 on 10-26.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Kalshi, U.S. diesel at year-end (12-31, U.S. average, not Lower Atlantic): Above $5.40: 0.79; $5.80: 0.69; $6.00: 0.65; $6.20: 0.49; $6.40: 0.36; $6.60: 0.26; $6.80: 0.20; $7.20: 0.16. That puts the implied U.S. median near $6.20. If the recent gap of about $0.45-0.55 holds, that corresponds to roughly $5.65-5.75 for the Lower Atlantic. This is a conversion, not a forecast.

- EIA STEO (released 2026-10-06): retail diesel stays above $6 in October and then eases gradually. It forecasts $5.19 for the 2026 average and $4.49 for 2027, with Brent at $105 in Q4 2026. [EIA STEO](https://www.eia.gov/outlooks/steo/)
- I found no forecast specific to the Lower Atlantic.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-11-03: Midterm elections. Trump's pledge not to strike Iran runs until then, so renewed strikes after the vote are possible.
- 2026-11-03 onward: weekly EIA diesel releases.
- 2026-11-10: November STEO.
- Through November: Russian diesel cargoes arrive under the deal. The IEA's diesel stock release continues.
- Late November: Thanksgiving demand, and the start of winter heating-oil demand in the Northeast.
- Ongoing risks: Hormuz tanker attacks and escorts, Houthi strikes on Saudi refineries, Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries, and a possible U.S. export ban (18% on Polymarket).
- The question's range of $4.4-6.8 brackets the year's Lower Atlantic range so far ($4.48-6.14).

forecasts.reasoning:
**(a) Time left:** About 8 weeks. The resolving value is the EIA price dated Monday 12/28/2026, likely published 12/29 or slightly later.

**(b) Latest known value:** Lower Atlantic on-highway diesel was $5.890/gal for 2026-10-26. The U.S. average was $6.352 the same week.

**(c) If nothing changed:** About $5.89.

**(d) If the recent trend continued:** The price rose from $5.645 to $5.890 over two weeks. Extrapolating that pace would push it above $6.3, toward the September high of $6.14 and beyond. Markets, however, expect November to be roughly flat and December to ease.

**(e) Historical variation:**
- In 2026, 9-week moves have ranged from about -$0.68 to +$1.52.
- In a calm year such as 2025, the same window moved only about -$0.12.
- A standard deviation of roughly $0.5-0.6 over this horizon seems right in the current regime, with fat tails in both directions.

**(f) Experts and markets:**
- Kalshi's U.S. year-end price implies a median near $6.20, with wide tails: about 21% below $5.40 and 16% above $7.20.
- The Lower Atlantic has recently traded about $0.46-0.54 below the U.S. average. That converts the Kalshi median to roughly $5.70-5.75 for the Lower Atlantic.
- Kalshi's 11/30 U.S. median is about $6.33, which implies a flat November.
- EIA's STEO projects a gradual easing.
- BMI expects high diesel prices to persist through Q1 2027.

**(g) Scenarios:**
- *Low:* A post-election de-escalation with Iran reopens Hormuz flows, Brent falls toward $80, and the IEA and Russian diesel supplies plus weak demand push Lower Atlantic diesel to about $4.5.
- *High:* U.S. strikes on Iran after the midterms, further Houthi damage to Saudi refineries and a cold Northeast winter send the U.S. average to a record above $7.5, putting the Lower Atlantic near $7+.

For the tails:
- The 1st percentile (about $4.25) corresponds to a full de-escalation collapse similar to the post-shock low of $4.48 in July.
- The 99th percentile (about $7.6) corresponds to a major Gulf supply disruption.

I anchor the median at about $5.75. I shade Kalshi's tails somewhat inward to allow for longshot bias in thin markets, while keeping the right tail fat.
